args.script:
#!/bin/bash

# Directory path
DIR="~/linux_problem/sample_dir"

# Count regular files (excluding hidden)
file_count=$(find "$DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -not -name ".*" | wc -l)

# Count directories (excluding hidden)
dir_count=$(find "$DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type d -not -name ".*" | wc -l)

# The find command includes the directory itself, so subtract 1 for the base directory
dir_count=$((dir_count - 1))

# Calculate sum
total=$((file_count + dir_count))

echo "$total"
